mobile.name: pony mount
mobile.long_descr: A small but sturdy pony stands here, waiting to carry its master.
mobile.description: This pony is nimble and reliable despite its modest size.

mobile.name: horse mount sturdy
mobile.long_descr: A sturdy horse stands here, saddled and ready for the road.
mobile.description: Built for endurance, this horse has a calm and dependable disposition.

mobile.name: warhorse mount war horse
mobile.long_descr: A powerful war horse stamps its hooves, eager to charge into battle.
mobile.description: Bred for combat, this horse is armoured with a fierce spirit.

mobile.name: dire wolf mount
mobile.long_descr: A massive dire wolf paces here, its golden eyes fixed on you.
mobile.description: Twice the size of a normal wolf, this beast is a fearsome mount.

mobile.name: eagle giant mount
mobile.long_descr: A majestic giant eagle spreads its wings here, regarding you keenly.
mobile.description: Its wingspan could blot out the sun. Few creatures can match its speed.

mobile.name: tabby cat familiar
mobile.long_descr: A sleek tabby cat watches you with intelligent amber eyes.
mobile.description: This nimble cat has an uncanny awareness of magical auras.

mobile.name: raven familiar
mobile.long_descr: A glossy black raven perches here, regarding you with bright eyes.
mobile.description: Ravens are prized familiars for their intelligence and excellent sight.

mobile.name: ferret familiar
mobile.long_descr: A lithe ferret scurries about, nose twitching at the magical air.
mobile.description: Ferrets make excellent familiars; their curiosity often uncovers hidden things.

mobile.name: bat familiar
mobile.long_descr: A small bat hangs nearby, its echolocation mapping every corner.
mobile.description: Bats are prized as familiars for their uncanny blind navigation.

mobile.name: toad familiar
mobile.long_descr: A plump toad squats here contentedly, blinking its golden eyes.
mobile.description: Toads are traditional wizard familiars, often associated with potions.

mobile.name: snake familiar
mobile.long_descr: A serpent coils nearby, tongue flickering as it senses its surroundings.
mobile.description: Snakes are familiars prized for their cold magical affinity.

mobile.name: hawk familiar
mobile.long_descr: A sharp-eyed hawk perches here, scanning the surroundings for threats.
mobile.description: Hawks are valued familiars for their keen vision and swift flight.

mobile.name: fox familiar
mobile.long_descr: A russet-furred fox paces here, its intelligent eyes watching everything.
mobile.description: Foxes are clever familiars, adept at sniffing out hidden threats.
